note: Synthetic demo data. The menu is copied from Sprint Serve's development seed. "popularity" only weights the generated order history; it is not real sales.
chefNotes: We cook North Indian food home-style and keep it mild unless a guest asks for heat. Our signature is the Dal Makhani; we like to serve it with Butter Naan. For a group, we suggest one main per two people plus breads.
